item.title: Lab 3/5 (Part 1): The Emergency Active Directory Audit
item.description: Addressing the security risks of an SSO federating an unhardened directory, this technical guide details an emergency Active Directory audit. Through a hands-on lab using Wazuh, PowerShell, and GPOs, discover how to quantify identity vulnerabilities (Kerberoasting, missing tiering, insecure service accounts) before remediating the source directory.
